time.note: Engine timing (SPEC-v3 §3, the dispatch model), whole ms of engine time. A sapper sent at a pixel pops it yardMs + tiles x tileMs + biteMs later (tiles = its walk distance + 1) and is home yardMs + tiles x carryMs after that; a space sends one sapper every staggerMs; an archer hit lands halfway out and the sapper is back knockMs plus the walk later. The ratios shape which pixels squads claim, so changing them needs a rebake. To slow or speed the whole game without changing any outcome, turn show.pace instead.

levels.name: Open Gate
levels.hint: Tap a squad. Its sappers march from the camp and each eats the nearest pixel of their colour.

levels.name: The Waiting Line
levels.hint: Sappers who can't reach their colour wait on the holding line, and march on their own once it opens up.

levels.name: Woodpile
levels.hint: A squad bigger than what's open eats what it can reach. The rest wait, then finish the job.

levels.name: The Locked Bridge
levels.hint: The iron gate won't budge. Send the Looters for the gold key and the gate swings open.

levels.name: Hidden Colours
levels.hint: A ? squad hides its colour until it reaches the front. Its count always shows.

levels.name: The Corner Tower
levels.hint: Sappers aimed inside the red ring get shot. Bring the tower down first.

levels.name: Linked Squads
levels.hint: Linked squads go out together and need 2 free spaces; both stay taken until both squads are home.

levels.name: The Locked Space
levels.hint: One space starts locked. Its key is a gold block on the board: dig it out and send the Looters.

levels.name: All at Once
levels.hint: Gates, archers, ? squads, linked squads and a locked space, all in one castle.
